title: Bulacan paper-cut art honors Gen. Gregorio del Pilar on 151st birth anniversary

blocks.text: BULAKAN, Bulacan, Philippines — Intricate paper-cut art called “borlas” featuring Gen. Gregorio “Goyo” del Pilar highlighted the celebration of the hero’s 151st birth anniversary in his hometown on Saturday, Nov. 14. Crafted by Beya Giron of Bulacan Salinlahi Inc., the artwork depicting Del Pilar’s face and name was displayed at the 166-year-old Ycasiano-Enriquez ancestral house, built in 1860 by Don Jacinto Ycasiano for his daughter Josefa, who married Col. Vicente Enriquez, the general’s aide-de-camp. Borlas, also known as “Sining Aninag,” originated in San Miguel, Bulacan, where it was traditionally used as decorative wrapping for the town’s famous pastillas de leche. The […]...
